services.name: Roof repair
services.short: Leaks, missing shingles and worn flashing fixed before they turn into rot.
services.long: Most leaks start at flashing, vents or a few lifted shingles, not the whole roof. We trace the water back to where it gets in, fix that spot and show you before and after photos. If a repair won't last, we'll tell you that too.
bullets: Leak tracing from the attic and the roof surface
Shingle, flashing, pipe boot and vent replacement
Closest available match to your existing shingles
Before and after photos with every repair

services.name: Roof replacement
services.short: Full tear-off and new roof, usually finished in one to three days.
services.long: We strip the old roof down to the deck, replace any soft or rotted boards and install a complete system: underlayment, ice and water shield, flashing, vents and shingles. The price you sign is the price you pay unless we find rotted decking, and that is priced per sheet in your contract.
bullets: Architectural asphalt shingles, metal and synthetic options
Ice and water shield in valleys and along the eaves
Rotted decking replaced at a per-sheet price set up front
Magnetic nail sweep and full cleanup every day

services.name: Storm damage and insurance claims
services.short: Hail and wind damage documented, tarped and repaired, with help on your claim.
services.long: After a storm we inspect, photograph every damaged area and tarp anything open to the weather. If it looks like a claim, we'll meet your adjuster on the roof and walk them through what we found. You pay your deductible; we don't waive it or hide it in the price.
bullets: Same-day tarping for open roofs
Photo report of hail and wind damage
We meet your adjuster on site
Repair or replacement once the claim is approved

services.name: Roof inspection
services.short: A full roof check with photos and a written report.
services.long: We check shingles, flashing, vents, gutters and the attic for signs of leaks or poor ventilation. You get a photo report that says what's fine, what to keep an eye on and what needs fixing now. Buyers and sellers can get the same report during a home sale.
bullets: Shingle, flashing and sealant condition
Attic check for moisture, daylight and ventilation
Estimated remaining life of the roof
Written report you can share with an insurer or buyer

services.name: Gutters and downspouts
services.short: New gutters formed to length on site, plus guards, repairs and cleaning.
services.long: We form aluminum gutters on site from one continuous piece per run, so the only joints are at the corners. Downspouts are sized and placed to move water away from your foundation, and we can add guards if trees keep filling them.
bullets: 5 and 6 inch aluminum gutters in common colors
Downspout extensions to carry water away from the foundation
Gutter guards for homes under heavy trees
Repairs for sagging, leaking or pulled-away sections

services.name: Flat and low-slope roofs
services.short: TPO, EPDM and modified bitumen for porches, additions and small commercial buildings.
services.long: Shingles aren't made for roofs with little or no pitch, and that's where a lot of leaks start. We install and repair single-ply membranes and modified bitumen on porches, additions, garages and small commercial buildings.
bullets: TPO and EPDM single-ply membranes
Modified bitumen for small low-slope sections
Tapered insulation to move water off and stop ponding
Repairs and coatings to extend an older membrane

services.name: Skylights, chimneys and flashing
services.short: Skylight and chimney leaks fixed at the flashing, where they usually start.
services.long: Skylights and chimneys are the most common places for a roof to leak, and caulk alone won't hold for long. We replace step and counter flashing, install new flashing kits, or swap out old skylights while the roof is being done.
bullets: Step and counter flashing on chimneys
Skylight flashing kits and full skylight replacement
Crickets built behind wide chimneys to shed water
Pipe boots and vent flashing replaced

trust.badges_hint: Manufacturer certifications (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed) carry the most weight because they let the roofer offer longer system warranties. NRCA or state roofing association membership, BBB accreditation and a HAAG inspector credential for storm work also help. Show the license number near the footer. The certifications listed are examples; keep only the ones the business holds, and swap in the higher tier when it applies (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster).

faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost?
faqs.a: It depends mostly on the size and pitch of the roof, how many layers come off and the material. National cost data puts most asphalt shingle replacements between about $6,000 and $14,000, with large, steep or metal roofs running higher. We give you a written, itemized price after the inspection, and it doesn't change unless we find rotted decking.

faqs.q: Can you repair my roof, or does it need replacing?
faqs.a: Many leaks come from flashing or a cracked pipe boot, and a repair fixes them. Most repairs land between $400 and $1,800. If the shingles are curling, shedding granules or past about 20 years old, repairs start to become money spent twice, and we'll show you photos so you can judge for yourself.

faqs.q: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most homes take one to three days once materials are delivered. Weather can move the start date, and we won't tear off a roof with rain in the forecast. You don't need to be home, but someone should be reachable by phone.

faqs.q: Will my homeowners insurance pay for it?
faqs.a: Insurance usually covers sudden damage from hail, wind or a fallen tree, not wear and age. We document the damage with photos and can meet your adjuster on the roof. You are responsible for your deductible, and in many states it's illegal for a roofer to waive it.

faqs.q: Can you put new shingles over my old ones?
faqs.a: Some building codes allow one overlay, but we almost always recommend a tear-off. Going over the old layer hides rotted decking, adds weight and can shorten the life of the new shingles. Some manufacturers also won't offer their longest warranties on an overlay.
Most cities and counties require a permit for a full replacement, and some require one for larger repairs. We pull the permit, schedule the inspection and include the cost in your estimate.

Two warranties. The manufacturer covers the shingles, and we cover our installation with a written workmanship warranty. If you choose a full manufacturer system, extended coverage may be available, and we register it for you.

faqs.q: What happens to my yard and driveway?
faqs.a: We cover plants and AC units with tarps, put boards under the dumpster to protect the driveway and park it where you want it. At the end of every day, we run a magnetic sweeper over the yard and driveway for nails.
